title: Color
slide_intent: Give the reader a clear pause before the palette system. A single section name signals that the next pages belong to one family of decisions.
strategic_value: Using the same divider as the other sections can make the palette easy to locate on a second reading.
demonstration: One large white word announces Color on the near-black background. The surrounding field remains open.
practical_value: Use this divider to introduce the sequence of primary, secondary and neutral palette pages.

content_islands.name: Book identifiers
content_islands.spec: Place a small white Bolt mark in the upper-left corner and the folio in the lower-left corner.

content_islands.name: Section title
content_islands.spec: Set “Color” in large white type on the dark full-page field. Align the title near mid-height, inset farther than the small identifiers.
